Polygon feature class representing the City of Somerville, Massachusetts zoning map adopted December 12, 2019 as part of the City of Somerville Zoning Overhaul (https://www.somervillezoning.com/).

Last amended by City Council December 12, 2024 per Ordinance 2024-16.

This dataset last updated April 4, 2025.
